title: MIXEVAL-X: ANY-TO-ANY EVALUATIONS FROM REAL-WORLD DATA MIXTURES

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the deviation of existing benchmark task distributions from real-world user queries using sentence embeddings and t-SNE visualization, and mitigating it by matching web-mined queries to benchmark tasks to reconstruct real-world distributions.

Evaluating discrepancies between automated metrics, LLM-as-a-judge scores, and crowd-sourced human preferences (Elo ratings) to identify unfair or inaccurate scoring paradigms in open-ended multimodal generation tasks.

Addressing evaluation contamination and model overfitting by implementing a dynamic benchmarking approach with an automated adaptation-rectification pipeline that periodically refreshes evaluation test sets.
